editor_version: Epic HoopoeEditor 1.1.390.0e; UE 4.26.2; configuration from project post-install evidence
scope_status: PROPOSED_BOUNDED_AI_SOURCE_COLLECTION; installed file identities and prior export reuse identities verified; new native exports NOT_PERFORMED

inspected_roots.selection_reason: Entire observed AI directory, recursively; directory names alone do not prove active use or allegiance.
Complete narrow order family; FollowOrder and SquadOrderBase already exported.
Complete narrow lance command family; several direct dispatcher dependencies.
Twelve named skill curves/modifier tables; path relevance only, no runtime linkage inferred.
Narrow behavior family; source name references from installed AI assets identify common parent and activation type.

inventory_method: rg --files -g *.uasset under exact listed roots; prior eighteen exact source paths; ten named supporting files. Standard-library raw ASCII string matching of the 191 AI files supplied package-name leads only. No native asset load, editor operation, or game action performed.

omitted_categories.category: DLC1 through DLC8 and mission-specific assets outside the named directories
omitted_categories.reason: No whole-install recursion or speculative expansion. Relevant references will be reported for later source review; installed content does not prove entitlement or active usage.
Asset text and generated API declarations do not contain all compiled native algorithms.

omitted_categories.category: Unit models, weapons/equipment, terrain, navigation data and effects outside allowlist
omitted_categories.reason: Large independent families, not assumed necessary for first tactical source map; named unresolved dependencies remain visible.

omitted_categories.category: Campaign saves, player profile data, live blackboards, actor instances, control state and mission recordings
omitted_categories.reason: Runtime/private state is outside source collection and cannot be reconstructed as measured behavior from asset exports.
This manifest is an exact .uasset allowlist; no assumption of total game-data coverage.

limitations: Broad coverage of the observed Content/AI directory is not a complete semantic map, proof of active root selection, or a guarantee of all data needed for the mod.
Enemy, allied and lancemate classifications require source tracing and runtime confirmation; directory categories only describe file organization.

New assets require an actual registry class check. REGISTRY_CLASS_REVIEW deliberately avoids inferring class from filenames. Unsupported classes must be reported, not silently loaded through a generic fallback.
Object paths are conventional package.basename targets derived from exact files; verify actual AssetData object path before load, report redirectors/mismatches.
No dynamic dependency crawl or automatic expansion. Unreal can still resolve hard dependencies and create normal cache/shader activity while loading allowlisted sources.
The prior eighteen outputs are reused only after current source and export hash matches. Reuse proves bytes, not prior complete semantic review.
Installed version comes from retained completion metadata and must be rechecked by the collector; this file only rehashed selected asset files.
No gameplay control, Play-In-Editor, explicit compile, save, cook, mod deployment, voice, paid service, credentials, or live tactical loop is performed by this inventory.

MW5_FunctionLibrary is METADATA_ONLY because its broad 18,090,466-byte source exceeds 16 MiB; record dependencies and identity without bulk loading/export. This is an explicit body-coverage gap, not full collection.
